name: Joypad-OS Steam Input Gamepad
notes: 179-byte descriptor. Source: joypad-ai/joypad-os sinput_descriptors.h at 9fa79f45. Steam Input compatible mode: 32 buttons, 4x 16-bit axes, 2x 16-bit axes, 1x 32-bit axis, 6x 16-bit gyro/accel axes, vendor data. Answers SDL's features command (output report 0x03 03 02) with a 64-byte input report 0x02: bytes 0 to 19 as joypad-os sends them with no pad attached (sinput_mode.c sinput_build_feature_response), then a serial of its own, 4A 4F 59 00 00 and the controller's index, where joypad-os sends its board's ID. OutputDecoded carries leftMotor and rightMotor from a type 2 haptics write, and lightbarRed, lightbarGreen and lightbarBlue, one byte each, from an RGB write. A player LED write, which joypad-os also acts on, decodes nothing.

layout.note: Pico-stack gamepad firmware (RP2040 VID 2E8A) presenting Steam Input. Hobbyist firmware with no published spec apart from its descriptor.
